structured_output.summary: The change implements the get ArrayBuffer.prototype.detached steps in the single in-scope file. Step 2 (RequireInternalSlot for [[ArrayBufferData]]) is done inline: a non-Object or a non-ArrayBuffer `this` throws a TypeError. Step 4 returns Boolean(is_detached_buffer(agent, obj)) from the existing helper. Step 3 (IsSharedArrayBuffer) has no inline code. The comment says the engine has no Shared Data Blocks, so a SharedArrayBuffer never matches ObjectKind::ArrayBuffer and already fails the step-2 check with the same TypeError. Step 3 has no observable effects, so this is not a skipped observable step. Errors propagate with the TypeError and nothing is swallowed. No test-shaped branches. The diff touches only the in-scope file. The gate reports 18 runs, 12 newly passing, 0 regressions.
structured_output.notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found. Step 3 relies on the invariant that SharedArrayBuffer objects are not stored as ObjectKind::ArrayBuffer. If shared buffers are added later, this file needs an explicit IsSharedArrayBuffer check before the detached read.
